# AC_PARTICIPANT_V0

## 1. Intent

The ordinary participant who registers themselves and is decided about

```yaml
artifact_kind: ACTOR

authority: pgc.platform
concern: identity
core:
  summary: The ordinary participant who registers themselves and is decided about
  type: ENDUSER
  attributes:
    contact_address:
      type: string
      required: true
    name:
      type: string
      required: true
    currency_preference:
      type: string
      default: BACHI
    language:
      type: string
      default: en
```
